summary: A bytebeat synth firmware built on Dinghy: it plays one-line formulas of t as sound, with the played note setting how fast t runs and the knobs changing numbers inside the formula.
features: 30 built-in patches: 8 tuned waveforms and 22 classic bytebeats
Write formulas on the device with a live error-checking compiler
Eight knob variables, colour-matched in the formula; random formula generator
Mono, detuned dual, 4-voice poly, or a different formula per side
Loop and ping-pong over any part of a formula; 64 named user slots
USB MIDI notes, pitch bend, 12 learnable CCs; no sequencer
